requirements.requirement: Use the exact Horner recursion with zero for the empty list and coefficients in increasing degree order.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:12-14 defines P [] x = 0 and P (a :: tail) x = a + x * P tail x, placing the constant coefficient first and hence using increasing degree order. Lines 28-31 prove both equations by reflexivity.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate each cons step using a rounded multiplication of x and the rounded tail, then a rounded addition of the coefficient.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:17-19 defines Q model [] x = 0 and Q model (a :: tail) x = model.round (a + model.round (x * Q model tail x)), with exactly the prescribed rounded product and rounded addition. Lines 33-36 prove the equations by reflexivity.
